reason: A DSH interface plugin that adds an animated progress dock with a desktop-pet character during deep-dive responses and optionally plays a completion sound.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 深度思考状态栏下方添加带有进度条、动画宠物和阶段文案的界面面板，并可在完成时播放提示音。
summaries.en: Adds an animated progress panel with a pet character and stage text below DSH’s deep-dive status line, with an optional completion sound.

capabilities: Adds an animated progress panel to the DSH deep-dive interface
Displays sprite-sheet animations and stage-specific text during running sessions
Plays a bundled completion audio file through a configurable host system command
Supports permanent auto-loading through the DSH plugin composition
